title.fr: Un traitement équitable devant la loi

text.en: Canada's justice system promises every person due process under the law.
text.fr: Le système de justice du Canada garantit à chaque personne l'application régulière de la loi.

source.quote: The Canadian justice system guarantees everyone due process under the law.

text.en: In a criminal case, the courts start from the idea that the accused person is innocent. A person is treated as innocent until it is proven that they are guilty.
text.fr: Dans une affaire criminelle, les tribunaux partent de l'idée que la personne accusée est innocente. Une personne est considérée comme innocente tant que sa culpabilité n'a pas été prouvée.

source.quote: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

text.en: Canada's legal system grows out of a long heritage. Four ideas from that heritage shape it: democratic principles, the rule of law, due process, and freedom under the law.
text.fr: Le système juridique du Canada repose sur un long héritage. Quatre idées tirées de cet héritage le façonnent : les principes démocratiques, la primauté du droit, l'application régulière de la loi et la liberté dans le cadre de la loi.

source.quote: Canada’s legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.

text.en: Due process means the government has to respect every legal right that a person has under the law.
text.fr: L'application régulière de la loi veut dire que le gouvernement doit respecter tous les droits qu'une personne possède selon la loi.

source.quote: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.
